prediction_sql:
SELECT winner_name, winner_rank
FROM matches
WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY winner_name, winner_rank
ORDER BY MIN(winner_age) ASC
LIMIT 3;
prior: matches has repeated match records. For this output, the ranking unit is a distinct (winner_name, winner_rank) combination, ordered by the youngest age observed for that combination. Distinct ranks of the same winner remain separate.
